verdict.rationale: Visual scripting is a fair question for a game engine, but the pack documents only code-based scripting (GDScript, C#, C++, GDExtension) and never mentions a visual scripting system. A community comment contrasts Godot unfavorably with Unreal's visual blueprints, which suggests no comparable no-code logic tool.

support.subject: As a technical artist, I can build gameplay logic with visual scripting without writing code
